prompt.project_info: A warm outdoor backlight portrait driven by sun flare, a weathered wooden railing, and a simple white knit.
prompt.main_subject: An adult East Asian woman with natural dark hair loosely gathered back, calm eyes, soft peach makeup, and natural skin texture. She wears a white crew-neck knit sweater, a light-blue denim midi skirt, and simple sandals.
prompt.composition_elements: Close vertical portrait beside a wooden railing, subject turning slightly back toward camera and shielding her eyes from the low sun with one hand. Blurred trees and park greenery remain behind her; omit text, logos, and graphic overlays.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong sunset backlight at approximately 3700K creates a rim-lit hair halo and soft hand-cast face shadow. Preserve slight peach fuzz, fabric weave, realistic skin variation, and gentle warm film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2, vertical 3:4 crop, focus on eyes, creamy park bokeh, soft highlight roll-off, subtle natural vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic golden-hour portrait of an adult East Asian woman beside a weathered wooden railing, turning slightly back toward camera while shielding her eyes from the low sun. She wears a white crew-neck knit sweater, light-blue denim midi skirt, and simple sandals. Strong warm backlight creates a halo around her hair, soft face shadow, blurred trees and park greenery in the background, calm gaze, natural skin texture and fine peach fuzz, close vertical portrait, dreamy realistic film look, no text or branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, off-shoulder styling, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, distorted face

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Identity reference is optional and must show an approved adult. Keep the white knit, blue denim skirt, wooden railing, one-hand sun-shield gesture, and golden backlight stable; identity and specific park can be replaced through references.
